about:
# WagoUI

WagoUI includes Install and Create workspaces. Packs contain independent profile records tagged into one or more variations; resolution is optional variation metadata.

Local drafts live in WagoUIDB.creator.packs. Explicitly saved captures live in WagoUIDB.creator.saved; reload writes them to disk for the companion app. WagoUI does not read or migrate the old creator database.

The Wago App reads saved packs and delivers installed packs following the [schema-v2 transport contract](https://github.com/methodgg/Wago-Creator-UI/blob/main/docs/wagoui-redesign/transport.md). UI Packs published by the previous creator are converted to schema 2 when WagoUI loads them; a pack that can't be converted is left out.

## Add-on authors

If you want your add-on to be supported in Wago and Wago UI packs, start by submitting it through the Wago add-on request form:

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdYdCJuXGx29oAkmzvkgbEnGSlWzXFld_qpChJhfNq2VvBjPA/viewform

Your add-on also needs to expose the profile-management API expected by `LibAddonProfiles` so WagoUI can import, export, compare, select, and configure profiles during pack setup.

### Integration guide

Full guide:
https://github.com/methodgg/Wago-Creator-UI/blob/main/WagoUI_Libraries/LibAddonProfiles/ImplementationGuide.lua

In short, the guide asks add-on authors to:

- Expose the integration functions on a dedicated global API table.
- Implement profile export and import so profiles can round-trip through your own import/export format.
- Provide profile decoding so Wago creators can compare profile data and generate changelogs.
- Provide helpers to list profile keys, read the current profile, and switch profiles.
- Provide config open and close hooks when your add-on has a configuration UI.
- Avoid calling `ReloadUI()` inside these integration functions. WagoUI handles reload timing after setup finishes.

If your add-on only has global settings and no profile system, the guide expects you to treat `"Global"` as the profile key.

releases.notes:
# 2.0.2 (2026-11-24)

- Fix UI Pack creators being unable to see or remove profiles of AddOns that are not installed, which kept those AddOns in the pack's included AddOns list
- Fix every WeakAuras group showing as changed after a WeakAuras update or game patch

# 2.0.1 (2026-11-17)

- Fix UI Pack creators being unable to save auras or profiles whose names start or end with a space

# 2.0.0 (2026-11-04)

The Creator is now part of WagoUI, and UI Packs use a new format built around variations.

- Merge WagoUI Creator into WagoUI: use /wago to install UI Packs and /wagoc to create them
- Replace fixed resolutions with variations: named profile sets that can each target several resolutions
- Convert UI Packs from the previous creator automatically, keeping install history
- New Full Install flow for first-time users and a reworked Individual Profiles view
- Bring back the Cooldown Manager and WeakAuras managers in the creator
- Block saving a UI Pack with profiles that can't be saved, and warn about profile names players already have
- Add a guided tour for first-time UI Pack creators
- Show a banner when WagoUI_Storage is disabled, with a button to enable it and reload
- Replace Details! Framework with WagoUI's own controls
- Remove the NaowhQOL and ElvUI Style Filters integrations
- Update interface versions for the latest WoW clients

# 1.9.2 (2026-10-12)

- Update interface versions for the latest WoW clients
- Require Cooldown Manager Centered 5.2.17 or newer
- Remove unused LibCompress library
